nodes.title: < - How to Use Extend Video Switch
widgets_values:
## How to Use Extend Video Switch

This workflow extends the video in steps (Base is **3 seconds**).

### Rule
Turn ON the **highest time you want**, and also turn ON **every step before it**.  
Do not skip steps.

### Examples

## **Want 9 seconds total**
✅ Enable: Up to 6 Sec  
✅ Enable: Up to 9 Sec  
❌ Disable: all options **longer than 9 Sec**

## **Want 14 seconds total**
✅ Enable: Up to 6 Sec  
✅ Enable: Up to 9 Sec  
✅ Enable: Up to 11 Sec  
✅ Enable: Up to 14 Sec  
❌ Disable: all options **longer than 14 Sec**

### Quick reminder
Target time = turn ON every toggle **up to** that time.  
Turn OFF every toggle **longer than** your target time.

nodes.title: Saving your final video
widgets_values:
### Saving your final video

In the **last `Video Combine`** node, you have two easy ways to save:

**Option A (automatic):**  
Turn **`save_output` = true**.  
This will save the final video to your output folder when you run the workflow.

**Option B (manual):**  
Leave **`save_output` = false**, then after the video generates, **right-click the preview** and choose **`Save Preview`**.
